reasons: The inserted Article XXI-A tracks the playbook preferred position element-for-element: up to six (6) months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of Licensee Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and subsequent deletion with written certification.

The 'missing' status is supported: Article XXI imposes return/certification obligations only on Licensee and preserves all Licensor rights, with no exit, data-return, or deletion mechanics anywhere in the termination articles.

The edit is additive and surgical — the original p0138 text is left untouched — and the self-contained definition of 'Licensee Data' is necessary because the agreement contains no equivalent defined term (only Licensor-side 'Confidential Information' and 'Licensed Technology').
The comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the required [Playbook] prefix, explains the asymmetry it fixes, and offers the 90-day/30-day export fallback without lecturing.
Deterministic checks are consistent (operation applies; data return/transition language present); medium severity is appropriate for a transition-assistance gap.
